Post-discharge monitoring. Repeat U&E and HbA1c requested.

blocks.text: Key: L = result below the quoted reference range. H = result above the quoted reference range. Reference ranges are those in routine use by this laboratory and may differ from those quoted by other providers. Results should not be compared directly with assays performed elsewhere.

Renal function: the estimated glomerular filtration rate is reduced at 52 mL/min/1.73m², with a correspondingly raised serum creatinine of 118 µmol/L. Sodium and potassium are both within the reference range on this specimen. A single reduced eGFR does not by itself establish chronicity, and the estimate is less reliable at extremes of muscle mass. Please interpret alongside earlier results and repeat renal profile as clinically appropriate.

Glycaemic control: HbA1c is raised at 58 mmol/mol against a laboratory reference range of 20 to 41 mmol/mol. This result reflects average glycaemia over the preceding two to three months and should be read in the context of any recent acute illness, transfusion or change in therapy.

Haematology: haemoglobin is marginally below the quoted reference range at 129 g/L. No further comment is offered on a single measurement. Please correlate all of the above with your clinical findings; this report is issued for the information of the requesting clinician and is not a clinical opinion.

Report authorised electronically by the duty clinical biochemist. Analyses performed at St Saviour's Hospital laboratory. Telephoned results are available on request; laboratory enquiries 01632 960118, quoting the laboratory number above.
